cd.title: Despacito
cd.situation: DJ K-Bit's 'Despacito' remix came out yesterday: 0 plays. He's at the bus stop holding his phone out to strangers. Everyone in the queue is scrolling.
cd.today: It started with one bus queue reaching for Shazam. DJ K-Bit's 'Despacito' remix went gold as the ringtone of 2017, and the shop sells the CD with a free phone sticker.

actions.label: accepted DJ K-Bit's AirDrop and made his remix your ringtone
actions.line: K-Bit pulls one headphone off. 'Finally, someone who looks up! Accept it.' Ping. His 'Despacito' remix is now your ringtone.

actions.label: joined the bus queue and let K-Bit ring you
actions.line: K-Bit rings you from the kerb. His remix blasts out of your pocket. Every head comes up: 'What IS this? Shazam it!' The bus comes. Nobody gets on.
actions.lockedLine: You join the queue. Nobody looks up. Your phone still has the factory ringtone, and K-Bit is still waiting for a listener.

offline.headline: The Bus Queue That Discovered DJ K-Bit
offline.article: On 13 January 2017 DJ K-Bit's 'Despacito' remix had zero plays. Then it rang out of one phone at a bus stop, the whole queue reached for Shazam, and the bus left empty. By summer it was the ringtone of the year, and its gold disc still hangs in Hollow Records.
